newsitem.title: JAPAN: All months of Tokyo corn futures end sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: All months of Tokyo corn futures end sharply lower.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures plunged on Tuesday, with all months down by the daily 400 yen limit at the closing, because of active technical selling by local investors, traders said.
The benchmark January 1998 contract was down 400 yen at 14,220 yen per tonne, and daily volume was 91,070 lots.
Active technical selling by local investors emerged from the opening, capping the topside of the market, traders said.
The selling accelerated by the afternoon, and all months hit their limit-lows, they said. "Investors assumed that price gains last week were excessive," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.65 per bushel at 0835 GMT, against $2.66-1/2 at Monday's close.
The spot January of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.00 at 0835 GMT, unchanged from Monday's close.
